_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Job Manual (Sanitized)
summary: The Job Manual presents detailed operation and maintenance information for maintenance technicians, covering all skill tasks including operating, corrective, and preventive maintenance, for use alone or with related technical manuals.
use_relationship:
The Job Manual presents detailed operation and maintenance information primarily intended for the maintenance technician. The manual contains all skill tasks for the equipment, including operating, corrective and preventive maintenance.

This data item description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for that data generated under the work task described by paragraph 3.1.2.4 of DS-89.

The Job Manual can be used alone or in conjunction with the other manuals developed by a contractor using DI-TMSS-81675, Equipment Technical Manual, DI-TMSS-81676, Subsystem Technical Manual, or DI-TMSS-81677, System Technical Manual.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference document
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the document cited herein, including its approval data and dates of any applicable amendments and revisions, shall be as stated herein. DS-89 (current edition) is available at the National Security Agency, Acquisition Logistics and Deployment Review, 9800 Savage Rd, Suite 6129, Fort Meade, Md. 20755-6129, Attn: DA023

preparation_instructions.title: Technical content and format
preparation_instructions.content: The Job Manual shall be in accordance with the technical content and format requirements of paragraph 3.5 of DS-89.

preparation_instructions.title: Illustration content
preparation_instructions.content: Illustrations shall be in accordance with the technical content for format requirements of paragraph 3.6 of DS-89 Illustrations and engineering drawings shall be in accordance with DI-DRPR-81678, Engineering Documentation Product Drawings, Sanitized, or DI-DRPR-81679, Engineering Documentation Product Drawings, Modified and Sanitized, as stated in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: General format
preparation_instructions.content: The Job Manual shall be in accordance with the format requirements of paragraph 3.7 of DS-89.

preparation_instructions.title: All references to GFE (Government Furnished Equipment)
preparation_instructions.content: All references to GFE (Government Furnished Equipment) shall be identified as CFE (Customer Furnished Equipment).

preparation_instructions.title: All references to the Government
preparation_instructions.content: All references to the Government, including specifications, standards, group designators, site names, NSA, DoD, etc., shall not be included in the manual.
